body:
>From the Unapack Web page http://www.paranoia.com/unapack
FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE: JANUARY 8, 1998
Contact: Michael Mello 1-802-763-8303 X2292

       STOP THIS TRIAL!

TED KACZYSNKI IS BEING DENIED HIS DAY IN COURT. Lawyers he
does not want are forcing him to stake his life on a defense he would
rather die
than raise. In the guise of providing him with his six amendment right
to assistance
of counsel, the Federal Government has stripped him of the only power he
has left
as an American citizen: the power to have HIS day in court, to put on
HIS defense,
in a judicial proceeding where HIS life is on the line -- not the lives
of his lawyers
or the judge. The judge's rulings yesterday turn the right to assistance
of counsel on
its head. The whole purpose of the right to assistance of counsel is to
EMPOWER
the citizen-accused. Ted Kaczynski has already been found competent to
stand trial
and to make important decisions relating to his defense. 

THIS TRIAL IS A TRAIN CRASH IN SLOW MOTION; A HALT MUST BE
CALLED IMMEDIATELY. Judy Clark and Quin Denvir should either put on the
defense that their client wishes, or move to withdraw WHEN OTHER COUNSEL
can take over the case with reasonable time and resources to prepare for
trial. In
either event, the trial should be delayed at least three months. 

ABANDONING TED TO REPRESENT HIMSELF PRO SE IS TO DEPRIVE
HIM OF COUNSEL. Ted is being forced to choose between going without a
lawyer or an insanity defense. He does not want to represent himself --
for very
good reasons. He wants a lawyer willing to abide by his wishes. He's
entitled to that
under the Sixth Amendment to the Constitution. 

WE DEPLORE THIS SHAMEFUL TRAVESTY OF JUSTICE. It is impossible
for Ted or anyone else, including Clarke and Denvir, to represent him
according to
his wishes in a trial that begins tomorrow. Judge Burrell is concerned
with getting
the trial started, but Ted Kaczysnki's right to his day in court when
his life is at
stake vastly outweigh any issues of convenience. 

There are news reports that Ted Kaczynski may have attempted suicide
last
night. 

THIS QUESTION BEGS TO BE ANSWERED: HOW HAS IT COME TO
THIS? 

"Our society tends to regard as a 'sickness'any mode of thought or
behavior that is inconvenient for the
system, and this is plausible because when an individual doesn't fit
into the system it causes pain to the
individual as well as problems for the system. Thus the manipulation of
an individual to adjust him to the
system is seen as a 'cure' for a 'sickness' and therefore as good." 
                                            ---The Unabomber Manifesto,
paragraph 155
                                   -END-
